observations.summary: FOG solidifies and accumulates in sewer pipes; cites EPA that grease is the most common cause (47 percent) of reported blockages; hot water and soap do not eliminate FOG.
observations.inference_limit: University extension fact sheet citing a 2012 EPA pretreatment document.

observations.summary: Santa Cruz County Sanitation District: never pour FOG down sinks or toilets; sewer spills pollute Monterey Bay; cool and bin grease, scrape plates, limit disposal use, use sink strainers.
Eliminate or limit garbage disposal use; never pour cooking oil or grease down the drain.
